features.name: climb_rate_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of the climbRate feature to provide a scaled input suitable for linear SVM margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves convergence and margin scaling for linear models by centering and standardizing a high-variance feature.

features.name: sgz_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of the Sgz feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures the Sgz feature contributes proportionally to the SVM decision boundary without dominating due to its scale.

features.name: pitch_roll_interaction
features.description: Cross-product of current pitch and current roll to capture non-linear aerodynamic interactions in a linear-friendly format.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to model the synergistic effects of pitch and roll without requiring a non-linear kernel.

features.name: abs_roll_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of absRoll from its mean, capturing the magnitude of roll extremity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of roll deviation, which is highly effective for margin-based classifiers.

features.name: dynamic_pressure_proxy
features.description: Proxy for dynamic pressure or aerodynamic force by multiplying the absolute values of pitch rate (q) and Sgz.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a physically meaningful composite feature that linearly correlates with aerodynamic stress.

features.name: alpha_pitch_ratio
features.description: Ratio of angle of attack (alpha) to current pitch, with a small constant added to the denominator to prevent division by zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights discrepancies between the angle of attack and the actual pitch, providing a strong linear signal for flight envelope boundaries.

features.name: roll_rate_severity
features.description: Sum of the absolute values of roll rate (p) and differential roll rate, representing the total roll volatility.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates roll rate metrics into a single continuous severity score, simplifying the feature space for the SVM.

features.name: climb_acceleration
features.description: Sum of the first and second differences of climb rate, representing the overall acceleration in the vertical plane.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines derivative terms into a single momentum feature, providing a smoother signal for the linear decision boundary.

features.name: extreme_climb_indicator
features.description: Assesses whether the climb rate and its derivatives indicate an extreme or unstable maneuver, returning a continuous severity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex, multi-variable thresholds into a single continuous risk score that a linear model can easily weight.

features.name: aerodynamic_instability_index
features.description: Evaluates the combination of pitch, roll, and their respective rates to determine the overall level of aerodynamic instability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, expert-like evaluation of flight stability, reducing the burden on the linear model to learn complex interactions.

features.name: control_surface_stress
features.description: Estimates the mechanical stress on control surfaces based on the magnitude of Sgz, p, and q.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a proxy for physical strain, offering a distinct, linearly separable dimension related to aircraft limits.

features.name: sensor_noise_level
features.description: Measures the aggregate noise or jitter across the diffSeTime variables to identify potentially unreliable sensor readings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the model to down-weight or adjust its confidence for rows with high sensor noise, improving overall robustness.
